sinopsis.es: Marco tiene 18 años. Mientras su madre insiste en internarlo en una clínica de rehabilitación, él está convencido de que solo necesita una última oportunidad para cambiar el rumbo de su vida.
sinopsis.en: Eighteen-year-old Marco is drifting through life after being expelled from school. His mother wants him admitted to a rehabilitation clinic, but he believes that all he needs is one last chance to turn his life around.
